text_blocks.snippet: Cervical cancer screening tests, primarily the Pap test and HPV test, are used to detect changes in cervical cells that could lead to cancer. The Pap test looks for abnormal cells, while the HPV test looks for high-risk types of HPV, a virus that can cause cervical cancer. These tests can be done separately or together (co-testing).
